Scope:
- After `.` trigger char: walk back to find the preceding identifier token.
- Resolve the identifier to a Binding via cypher-hir position-aware resolution.
- If the binding has a known label, query schema.node_properties(label) and return each PropertyDecl as a CompletionItem.

Acceptance:

title: TCK v1 parser gap: implement 15 ignored scenarios
description:
Follow-up to cy-zjv's conformance baseline. 15 of 40 v1 green-tag scenarios are #[ignore]'d because the parser has not yet implemented their grammar rule. Baseline: crates/cypher-tck/tck/v1-baseline.md.

Each row below is roughly one focused grammar + AST + HIR + sema + dialect-gate + snapshot sub-bead. File as children under this one as they get picked up:

- WITH clause (3 scenarios: simple projection, WHERE filter, ORDER BY LIMIT).
- CREATE clause.
- MERGE clause.
- SET clause.
- REMOVE clause.
- DELETE clause (detach delete too).
- UNWIND ... AS v clause.
- List literal `[1, 2, 3]`.
- Map literal `{a: 1, b: 'two'}`.
- Function call expression (unlocks `count(...)`, `sum(...)`, etc).
- Variable-length path quantifier `*1..3`.
- Named path `p = (...)`.

Acceptance:
- Each feature is implemented in cypher-syntax (grammar + kind), cypher-ast codegen regenerates, cypher-hir lowering updated, cypher-sema gate + kind rules updated.
- The matching entry in tck/v1.toml drops its `ignore = true` flag.
- `cargo test -p cypher-tck --test harness` reports TCK v1: 40/40 scenarios passed (0 ignored).
- Update crates/cypher-tck/tck/v1-baseline.md to the new pass rate.

Dependencies:

- `demo/samples/*.cyp` — a handful of queries:

    * `unclosed_paren.cyp` — parser recovery + syntax diagnostic
    * `unknown_var.cyp` — sema diagnostic (name resolution)

  Each paired with a comment at the top of the file showing expected diagnostic code(s).

Out of scope: vhs recording (separate follow-up), vscode extension, hover (v1-deferred per cy-gc4).

Acceptance:

title: CLI: wire check to real diagnostics pipeline via Database (spec §16)
description:
spec §16. `cypher-cli/src/main.rs` is still wired to `LegacyDatabase`, whose `diagnostics()` returns an empty `DiagnosticsSink` (crates/cypher-db/src/lib.rs:416). So `cypher check` silently passes on inputs that do produce diagnostics via the real pipeline (the LSP uses `Database::all_diagnostics` and works correctly).

Migration path:

- Swap `LegacyDatabase` → `Database` (same API the LSP uses: `open_file` / `update_file` / `all_diagnostics`).
- Render diagnostics using `cypher-diag`'s existing `render_text_stderr` (codespan-reporting backend — already rustc-style per §10.3).
- Respect spec §16 exit codes: `0` clean, `1` diagnostics-present (any `Severity::Error`), `2` usage (clap already handles), `3` internal.
- Also migrate `parse` and `fmt` to `Database` so we don't have two pipelines; the `--dialect` flag needs to flow through via `DialectMode` on `open_file`.
- `plan` / `explain` remain stubs until the grammar/plan lowering lands (spec §4.3 / §12).

Depends on `cypher-diag` rendering (already shipped). No deps to add beyond `cypher-diag` in `cypher-cli/Cargo.toml`.

Acceptance:
- `echo 'MATCH (n WHERE x' | cypher check` emits at least one `error[Exxxx]` with source underline and returns exit 1.
- `echo 'MATCH (n) RETURN n' | cypher check` emits nothing and returns exit 0.
- Existing `tests/integration.rs` still passes; add one new test for the error path.
- `cargo xtask gate` clean.
close_reason: Verified already done. cypher-cli/src/main.rs uses Database (not LegacyDatabase), renders via cypher_diag::render_text_stderr, returns exit 1 on errors and 0 on clean input, threads --dialect through. Test: echo "MATCH (n WHERE x" | cypher check emits both E1001 + E0011 with rustc-style underlines and exits 1; echo "MATCH (n) RETURN n" | cypher check exits 0. Plan/Explain still print stubs per bead carve-out (grammar/plan lowering deferred).

title: Agent complete/hover: explicit v1 deferral or minimal impl
description:
spec §15.2. crates/cypher-agent/src/main.rs complete and hover ops currently return empty arrays / empty objects (lines 13-14, 607, 616). The audit flagged these as "stubs" — they ship but aren't semantically useful.

Pick a lane:

(a) Ship a minimal v1 impl now: complete returns keyword + schema-label suggestions at the cursor; hover returns the resolved type + docs where available. Both already have most of the pipeline (parse → sema → resolved_names) running.

(b) Accept as v1-deferral: rename to "v2 stubs" in the JSON protocol doc, make them return { "deferred": true } with a code, add a spec note.

Acceptance (either path):
- Behaviour is explicit in docs/specs (not a silent empty response).
